page.layout: One page of text in a single column, Hebrew-Latin dictionary entries. Large Hebrew headwords hang at the left of their entries. Foot: a gathering signature. No margin notes. Running head at top right.

main_text.p: potest, ut precedens, ad זרר, per geminationem prima radicalis, ut in כרכוב & aliis pluribus.
זרח Ortus, Exortus fuit: Futur. יִזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ Orietur sol, 2.Sam.23.4.
זָרַח m. Ortus: Aff. לְנֹגַהּ זָרְחֶךָ Ad splendorem ortus tui, Jesa.60.3.
אֶזְרָח m. Indigena, quasi, Ibi, ubi vivit, Oriundus, Lev.16. v.29. כְּאֶזְרָח רַעֲנָן Sicut arbor indigena virens, Psal.37.35. Constr. וּכְאֶזְרַח הָאָרֶץ Et sicut indigena terrae, Exod.12.19.
מִזְרָח m. Ortus, Oriens, Pars mundi orientalis: לְמִזְרָח Ad orientem, Neh.3.26. Constr. מִזְרַח שֶׁמֶשׁ Ad ortum solis, Deut.4.47.
זרם Inundavit: Praeter. זְרַמְתָּם Inundasti eos, Psal. 90.5. Pih. Praet. וְזִרְמוּ עֲבוֹת [?] Exundarunt aquas nubes, Psal.77.18. Cholem est loco Tzere.
זִרְמָה f. Fluxus: Const. & cum Aff. בְּזִרְמַת סוּסִים זִרְמָתָם Et sicut fluxus equorum fluxus eorum, Ezech.23.20.

זרע Seminavit, Sevit: Praeter. אִם זָרַע Quum sevisset Jud.6.3. זָרְעוּ חִטִּים Seminarunt tritica, Jer.12. v.13. Niph. Praeter. נִזְרַעְתֶּם Seminabimini, Ezech.36.9. נִזְרָעָה זֶרַע Seretur semine, Numer.5.28. Futur. יִזְרַע זֶרַע אֲשֶׁר יִזְרַע Semen satívum, quod seminari solet, Lev.11.37. Pyh. Praet. אַף בַּל זָרְעוּ Etiam non sati sunt, Jes.40.24. Hiph. Particip. מוֹרִיעַ זֶרַע Sementans semen, Genes.1.11. Futur. כִּי תַזְרִיעַ Quum seminaverit, Lev.12.2.

זֶרַע m. Semen, Sementis: זֶרַע אַחֵר Semen aliud, Gen.4. v.25. Aff. זַרְעוֹ בּוֹ Semen ejus in eo, Gen.1.11. Plural. cum Aff. וּזְרַעֵיכֶם Et semina vel sata vestra, 1.Samuel.8. v.15. Chald. בְּזֶרַע אֲנָשָׁא Semine humano, Dan.2.42.
זֶרַע Idem: Construct. כְּזֶרַע גַּד [?] Sicut semen coriandri, Numer.11.7.

page.notes: Large Hebrew headwords (זרח, זרם, זרע) are set in display type at the left of their entries and are transcribed inline. Several vowel-pointed Hebrew forms are hard to read at this resolution and are marked [?], notably וְזִרְמוּ עֲבוֹת and כְּזֶרַע גַּד. Printed "Jesa.60.3." and "Jes.40.24." are as printed. Numerals and references are copied as printed. The running head is the Hebrew headword זר.
